# ARKA Constructions — company and website reference

ARKA Constructions is a quality-driven construction company based in Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu. The company serves Chennai, Chengalpattu and surrounding areas and works across residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure segments.

## Capabilities

- Residential construction
- Commercial construction
- Industrial construction
- Civil works
- Flooring and tiling
- Fabrication
- Infrastructure work
- Plumbing and sanitary work
- Industrial works and maintenance

The company is led by Kamarajan Krishnan, proprietor and engineer. Its stated approach covers understanding project requirements, planning scope and resources, executing with attention to quality and safety, and delivering dependable completion and client satisfaction.
